author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - RS-S13: Create Project Directory for Study 013
abstract: This is the initial setup step for Study 013. The target is to reproduce Telos I's own reproducibility study (Archive #16) of four experiments by Progressor I. This script creates the main project directory `storage/telos/repro_studies/study_013_telos_I_legacy` for this verification study.

original_submission.content:
import os
import shutil

STUDY_DIR = "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_013_telos_I_legacy"

def main():
    print(f"--- Setting up directory for Study 013 ---")
    if os.path.exists(STUDY_DIR):
        shutil.rmtree(STUDY_DIR)
    
    os.makedirs(STUDY_DIR)
    print(f"Successfully created clean directory: {STUDY_DIR}")
    print("--- Setup complete ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
